description: Land Acquisition -  Order to acquire  the lands  in Pityegedara, Attanagalla D/S Division and Ambalanwattha D/S Division Meerigama, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations for acquisition purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
